cohort: 40 children with food allergy and 30 children without food allergy
finding: This study found a significant association between food allergy and higher serum adiponectin levels in children, independent of obesity.
mod_finding: The study found a significantly higher Caesarean section rate in the group with food allergies (64.9%) compared to the control group (16.7%).
followup_time: 18.5 months (median) for children with food allergy, 23.5 months (median) for children without food allergy
